This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
. 2 .  Heard learned counsel for the Parties.

3. The present Writ Petition has been filed with the following prayer:-
"It is therefore, most humbly prayed that your Lordships would be graciously pleased to issue Rule NISI calling upon the Opposite Parties to show cause as to why the Annexure-2 shall not be paid the compensation for acquisition of the land, structure,
trees as per the market value with interest of 12% and solatium 100% for acquisition of the land of the petitioner.
And why shall not be taken into consideration of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013."
4.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In course of hearing, learned counsel for the Petitioner states that highlighting his grievances, the Petitioner has made a representation to Opposite Party No.2 vide Annexure-D/2 and the same may be directed to be considered within a stipulated time, to which learned Counsel for the State has no objection.

5. As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.2 to consider the representation filed by the petitioner vide Annexure-D/2 and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of two months from the date of Babuli Rout vs Project Director on 17 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176728972/
1 production of certified copy of this order.
